# my-pi-config

Personal Pi agent configuration.

Includes:

- background terminals + `/ps` UI
- subagents
- workflows
- `ask_user` multiple-choice tool
- shared helper modules, skills, themes, and `settings.json`

## Install

Clone this repo to your Pi agent config directory, then install dependencies:

```sh
git clone git@github.com:aarsh21/oh-senpi.git ~/.pi/agent
cd ~/.pi/agent
npm install
```

Restart Pi or run `/reload`.
